name: Cobalt Thiocyanate (Scott Reagent)
substanceClass: Cocaine HCl & Cocaine Base (Crack) - Presumptive Only
disclaimer: Illustrative profile for presumptive screening. Must be calibrated on physical kit batches.
reagentSteps: 1. Add suspect powder/residue into ampoule 1 (Cobalt Thiocyanate in water/glycerin).
2. Break ampoule 2 (Hydrochloric acid) and observe blue precipitate formation.
3. Break ampoule 3 (Chloroform) and shake for 10 seconds. Observe bottom layer color at 30 seconds.

outcomes.label: Cobalt Blue Precipitate / Organic Layer (Positive Indication)
outcomes.description: Characteristic brilliant cobalt blue in the bottom chloroform layer indicates presumptive presence of cocaine.

outcomes.label: Pinkish / Clear (Negative Indication)
outcomes.description: Remaining pink unreacted solution indicates absence of detectable cocaine threshold.

outcomes.label: Dirty Brown / Turbid
outcomes.description: Ambiguous turbidity from adulterants or excessive cutting agents.

name: Marquis Reagent (Formaldehyde-Sulfuric Acid)
disclaimer: Illustrative profile for presumptive screening. Strongly time-sensitive color development.
reagentSteps: 1. Place a pinhead amount of sample onto porcelain test well.
2. Dispense 1 drop of Marquis Reagent directly onto sample.
3. Start reaction timer immediately. Read color development between 30 and 60 seconds.

outcomes.label: Deep Purple / Violet (Presumptive Opiates / Heroin / Morphine)
outcomes.description: Rapid development of deep purple/violet indicates morphine, codeine, or heroin.

outcomes.label: Orange to Red-Brown (Presumptive Amphetamine / Methamphetamine)
outcomes.description: Immediate orange transitioning to reddish-brown indicates amphetamine or methamphetamine.

outcomes.label: Clear / Pale Straw (No Reaction)
outcomes.description: Absence of color change indicates no detectable target alkaloids.

name: Duquenois-Levine Reagent
disclaimer: Illustrative profile for presumptive screening. Three-phase extraction read.
reagentSteps: 1. Add crushed vegetative material or extract to tube.
2. Add Duquenois reagent and concentrated hydrochloric acid; agitate.
3. Add chloroform; observe color transfer into bottom layer at 60 seconds.

outcomes.label: Indigo / Violet Chloroform Layer (Positive Indication)
outcomes.description: Transfer of violet-blue dye into the lower chloroform layer indicates presumptive cannabinoids.

outcomes.label: Colorless / Pale Green Upper Layer (Negative Indication)
outcomes.description: Absence of violet color transfer into the organic chloroform layer.
